Name: Gandalf
Text: Sorry for being late!

Name: Gandalf
Text: Oh... looks like im just in time..

Name: Gandalf
Text: Welcome to the Workshop!

Name: Gandalf
Text: This is where I shall teach you the important things you will face throughout your journey.

Name: Gandalf
Text: My name's Gandalf

Name: Gandalf
Text: And for you to save Biringan, I will guide you through the Weather Patterns in the Philippines

Name: Gandalf
Text: Are you ready?

Name: Gandalf
Text: But first, let us warm up! I will show you some images.

Name: Gandalf
Text: Look at these images carefully...

Name: Gandalf
Text: Which of these images shows a Sunny Day?

Name: Gandalf
Text: Wonderful! That is indeed a Sunny Day! The sky is clear and bright.

Name: Gandalf
Text: Hmm, not quite! Look for the one with a clear bright sky and no clouds.

Name: Gandalf
Text: Now, which of these images shows a Rainy Day?

Name: Gandalf
Text: Excellent! Dark clouds and falling rain — that is a Rainy Day!

Name: Gandalf
Text: Not this one! Look for dark clouds and falling raindrops.

Name: Gandalf
Text: Which of these images shows a Cloudy Day?

Name: Gandalf
Text: Yes! Grey skies with no rain yet — that is a Cloudy Day!

Name: Gandalf
Text: Almost! Look for grey skies covered with clouds but no rain.

Name: Gandalf
Text: Great job! You are ready for today's lesson.

Name: Gandalf
Text: We will learn six important words today. Are you ready?

Name: Gandalf
Text: Our first word... WEATHER!

Name: Gandalf
Text: Weather is how the sky looks and feels TODAY.

Name: Gandalf
Text: Is it sunny? Is it rainy? Is it windy? That is the weather!

Name: Gandalf
Text: Weather can change every single day!

Name: Gandalf
Text: Our second word... CLIMATE!

Name: Gandalf
Text: Climate is the usual weather of a place for MANY YEARS.

Name: Gandalf
Text: For example, the Philippines usually has a hot and rainy climate.

Name: Gandalf
Text: Here is a fun way to remember it — Weather is your mood today. Climate is your personality!

Name: Gandalf
Text: Our third word... SEASON!

Name: Gandalf
Text: A Season is a time of year with the same kind of weather.

Name: Gandalf
Text: The Philippines has two seasons — the Wet Season and the Dry Season!

Name: Gandalf
Text: During the Wet Season, it rains a lot. During the Dry Season, it is hot and sunny.

Name: Gandalf
Text: Our fourth word... MONSOON!

Name: Gandalf
Text: A Monsoon is a strong wind that brings rain or dry weather.

Name: Gandalf
Text: The Philippines has two monsoons — the Amihan and the Habagat.

Name: Gandalf
Text: The Amihan is a cool northeast wind that brings dry and cold weather.

Name: Gandalf
Text: The Habagat is a warm southwest wind that brings heavy rain!

Name: Gandalf
Text: Our fifth word... AIR MASS!

Name: Gandalf
Text: An Air Mass is a big bunch of air that is hot, cold, wet, or dry.

Name: Gandalf
Text: Imagine a giant invisible bubble of air floating over the land or ocean.

Name: Gandalf
Text: That bubble carries its temperature and moisture wherever it goes!

Name: Gandalf
Text: And our sixth word... FRONT!

Name: Gandalf
Text: A Front is where two different air masses meet.

Name: Gandalf
Text: When a warm air mass meets a cold air mass, interesting things happen!

Name: Gandalf
Text: It can bring rain, strong winds, or even storms!

Name: Gandalf
Text: Now let us do a quick recap of all six words!

Name: Gandalf
Text: WEATHER — how the sky looks and feels TODAY.

Name: Gandalf
Text: CLIMATE — the usual weather of a place for MANY YEARS.

Name: Gandalf
Text: SEASON — a time of year with the same kind of weather.

Name: Gandalf
Text: MONSOON — a strong wind that brings rain or dry weather.

Name: Gandalf
Text: AIR MASS — a big bunch of air that is hot, cold, wet, or dry.

Name: Gandalf
Text: FRONT — where two different air masses meet.

Name: Gandalf
Text: Amazing work today! You have learned six important words.

Name: Gandalf
Text: Now go and use this knowledge on your journey through Biringan!
